title: System
about: Live CPU, memory, load, disks, network and disk I/O, top processes, failed services and containers; alerts when a server needs you.

events.message: Out of memory: the kernel killed a process
Needs a restart to finish updates

columns.title: CPU
columns.help: % of one core, as top shows it: on 4 cores up to 400 %

columns.title: Mem
columns.help: Memory the process holds in RAM, of all the server has

columns.title: RSS
columns.help: Memory the process holds in RAM (resident set)

columns.title: State
columns.help: R running · S sleeping · D waiting for I/O · Z zombie: its parent hasn't collected it · T stopped · I idle kernel thread

columns.title: Unit
columns.help: The systemd unit it runs in. A service set to restart starts a killed process again: manage the service instead

actions.title: Open Folder
actions.command: readlink /proc/{pid}/cwd || { echo 'That process has ended, or the kernel hides where it runs.' >&2; exit 1; }

actions.title: Open Files
actions.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null; then lsof -p {pid} 2>/dev/null | head -200; else ls -l /proc/{pid}/fd | head -200; fi

actions.title: Stop…
actions.message: Send TERM to {command} (pid {pid}): it's asked to stop, and may take a few seconds.
actions.command: if [ "$(tr '\n' ' ' 2>/dev/null < /proc/{pid}/stat | sed 's/.*) //' | cut -d' ' -f20)" = {start} ]; then kill -TERM {pid}; else echo 'That process has ended, or another one has its pid now: nothing was sent.' >&2; exit 1; fi

actions.title: Kill…
actions.message: Send KILL to {command} (pid {pid}): it ends at once, and unsaved work in it is lost.
actions.command: if [ "$(tr '\n' ' ' 2>/dev/null < /proc/{pid}/stat | sed 's/.*) //' | cut -d' ' -f20)" = {start} ]; then kill -KILL {pid}; else echo 'That process has ended, or another one has its pid now: nothing was sent.' >&2; exit 1; fi

actions.title: Biggest Folders
actions.command: out=$(timeout 110 du -xk -d1 {mount} 2>/dev/null); case $? in 124|143) echo 'Took too long: try a folder deeper.' >&2; exit 1;; 126|127) echo 'This server has no timeout or du.' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '%s\n' "$out" | sort -rn | head -15

actions.title: Biggest Folders Inside
actions.command: out=$(timeout 110 du -xk -d1 {path} 2>/dev/null); case $? in 124|143) echo 'Took too long: try a folder deeper.' >&2; exit 1;; 126|127) echo 'This server has no timeout or du.' >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '%s\n' "$out" | sort -rn | head -15

actions.title: Deleted Files Still Open
actions.note: Removed files a process still holds: df counts their space, du doesn't. It comes back when the process closes them or ends.

list.title: {path}
list.empty: No deleted file is held open on {mount}.

actions.title: Stop…
actions.message: Send TERM to {command} (pid {pid}): it's asked to stop, and may take a few seconds.
actions.command: if [ "$(tr '\n' ' ' 2>/dev/null < /proc/{pid}/stat | sed 's/.*) //' | cut -d' ' -f20)" = {start} ] && case "$(readlink /proc/{pid}/fd/{fd} 2>/dev/null)" in *' (deleted)') true;; *) false;; esac; then kill -TERM {pid}; else echo 'That process has ended, or closed that file: nothing was sent.' >&2; exit 1; fi

actions.title: Kill…
actions.message: Send KILL to {command} (pid {pid}): it ends at once, and unsaved work in it is lost.
actions.command: if [ "$(tr '\n' ' ' 2>/dev/null < /proc/{pid}/stat | sed 's/.*) //' | cut -d' ' -f20)" = {start} ] && case "$(readlink /proc/{pid}/fd/{fd} 2>/dev/null)" in *' (deleted)') true;; *) false;; esac; then kill -KILL {pid}; else echo 'That process has ended, or closed that file: nothing was sent.' >&2; exit 1; fi
